limits: Netzer calls Plans 17-22 "partly reconstructed" (captions) and "schematic" (p. 100); no legend separating found from restored lines was found in the inspected pages. lineStyle records the drawing only. For a few elements the text states that the drawn feature is missing or hypothetical (conduit between the pools, p. 78; drain to A(B)215, p. 94; channel from A(B)217, p. 83-84; dismantled Stage 5 conduit, p. 97); those notes cite the text, not a key.
The detailed plans that separate the phases (Plans 14, 15, 23, folded) are not in the supplied copies; all geometry comes from the schematic plans and the overview.
Plans 17/20/22 crop the pools at their western ends; the eastern ends and east walls come from the small-scale overview Fig. 18 (0.24 m per pixel) and the published wall thickness.

Fig. 18 north differs from Netzer Plans 17/20/22 north by about 2.6 deg; the frame follows Netzer's detailed plans. Grid or true north is not stated in any source; no geographic coordinates are given.
Plan 22 is a faint scan: all its labels and spot levels are illegible. Herodian identifications (W43, W57, winepress A(B)58, podium) come from the text, not from labels.
Wall and column heights are not published in the inspected pages; walls and columns carry height.basis "illustrative" with value null. Pool walls carry published top (+100.40) and floor levels only.
The Herodian rim level is unresolved: p. 85 says the new garden level called for raising the pool walls, but no trace of raising survived.

Not traced: the buildings west of the moat in the upper left of Plans 20 and 22 (Fortified Palace area); the Stage 4, 5 and 7 plans (Plans 18, 19, 21); the separate Area AC pools (Trumper Fig. 19); the thin single line and small dashed rectangle near W247 in Plan 20; unlabelled lines at the right edge of Plan 22; dashed stylobate lines along the column rows; partition walls inside the winepress vats.
The illustrated volume extract (pp. 69-72) shows Qarantal/Cypros only; it gives no isometric, elevation or heights for the Pools Complex. None found.
The flowerpot rows of the Herodian garden (p. 85: rows 2.4 m and 4.8 m west of the pool) are not drawn on Plan 22 in a legible way and are not traced.
